assumptions.choice: Implemented the SMA26-derived trailing stop as Backtrader Stop orders, canceling and replacing only when the stop improves in the specified trade direction.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires a dynamic trailing stop but does not specify an order type; Stop orders are the closest literal Backtrader implementation.

assumptions.choice: Required SMA9 to be below SMA26, rather than requiring a crossover.
assumptions.reason: The specification explicitly permits SMA9 being below SMA26 for short entries.

assumptions.choice: Canceled an active protective stop before submitting a cloud-based exit order.
assumptions.reason: This prevents an obsolete stop from remaining active after an explicit position-close signal.
